summary: A school or training provider (preschool, nursery, driving school, language or skills course) with programmes or courses, a schedule, fees, teachers and an enrolment or sign-up flow.

pages.purpose: Show what learners get, how a day or a course runs, who teaches, what it costs and how to start, ending at a visit or sign-up.

sections.purpose: Headline promise with photos of the setting and the next concrete step (next open morning, next course start).
fields: Photos of the setting or lessons
Next open day / course start date
Primary action: apply or sign up; secondary: visit or see courses
sections.notes: For a driving school the hero card can show a test route with its stops; for an early-years setting, the next open morning with date and time.

sections.purpose: Results and facts: pass rate, group sizes, teacher ratio, years open.
fields: Figures with label, period and source

sections.purpose: How a day (or a course) runs, per age group or course, as a proportional timeline.
alternatives: steps: a course shown as stages to the exam
fields: Blocks of the day with start/end time and what happens
sections.notes: Group switch as a keyboard-operable tablist. A live 'now' marker and a 'play the day' walk-through are optional extras; honour reduced motion and keep the day readable as a static list on phones.

sections.purpose: The age groups, programmes or courses with the key facts of each.
alternatives: comparison-table: courses that differ by many attributes
sections.notes: For courses, a bar per course sized by weeks to completion makes duration easy to compare.

sections.purpose: How we work, or the steps from first lesson to exam.
alternatives: feature-grid: an approach described as principles

sections.purpose: Teachers or instructors with their qualifications.
Words from parents or former learners.
fields: Source if from a review site

sections.purpose: A fee summary with what is included.
fields: Fee per plan (monthly or per course) with currency and tax
What is included (meals, materials, exam fees)

sections.purpose: Address, map, office hours and how to visit.
Age requirements, settling in, payment, failing an exam, switching course.

fields: Enrolment action and what happens next

pages.purpose: Everything about each programme or course: groups, the full day or the course comparison, term dates, what to bring, fees.

sections.purpose: Compare courses side by side: a licence/level switch re-prices the columns, a pace slider recomputes weeks to completion, 'only differences' hides identical rows, and the chosen column carries to sign-up.
alternatives: pricing-table: two or three simple packages
sections.notes: Announce changed prices and weeks in a status region.

sections.purpose: Each age group in detail with the full day.
Term dates, holidays and start dates.
alternatives: calendar: many start dates through the year

sections.purpose: What to pack or bring (documents, clothing, equipment).

pages.purpose: Apply or sign up in a few short steps with a live fee or total, and a clear 'what happens next'.

sections.purpose: How many steps, whether applying commits you, how places are offered.
fields: How applications are handled and places offered

sections.purpose: Steps: learner (child's details, start month) → days or course and pace with a live monthly fee/total → visit or start week → parent or learner contact and consent.
alternatives: form-01: a single-page sign-up for adult courses
fields: Start months or start weeks offered
sections.notes: The running fee is a role=status aria-live region. Validate per step with errors next to their fields; an age check error stays visible beside the birth-date field. Carry the course chosen on the programmes page into the form. Collect only what is needed about a child.

content: School/provider name, address, map, hours and contact
Programmes, age groups or courses with what each includes
Daily schedule per group, or lessons and pace per course
Fees per programme with inclusions, discounts and payment options
Figures: pass rate, group sizes, ratios (with period and source)
Enrolment steps, minimum age, documents required

styles.name: soft playful
styles.why: Rounded display type over a very legible text face, soft glass surfaces and springy but short motion; for preschools and children's activities.

styles.name: signal grotesk
styles.why: Heavy grotesk headings and a strong signal accent; suits driving schools and skills courses that sell on results.

styles.name: calm institutional
styles.why: Quiet, trustworthy look for private schools and tutoring centres.

pitfalls: Photos of children without parental consent, or identifiable faces and names.
Collecting more child data than needed, or without a privacy notice for parents.
Fees shown without what is included, the billing period, tax or extra exam fees.
Pass rates or results without period and source.
Timelines and live markers that only work with animation or as a wide graphic; keep a static text version.
Age and licence requirements only checked after submission; state them up front and next to the field.
Choices made on the course comparison lost on the way to the sign-up form.
